completedActions.name: Add guard check in playSegmentAt() dispatch closure to re-verify isPlaying state before calling playText()
Verify fix handles pause between segments correctly
Test pause button mashing doesn't cause chaos

name: foreground SuttaPlayer does not pause

references.text: Race condition occurs at lines 456-459 in SuttaPlayer.swift: DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter closure needs guard check for isPlaying

SuttaPlayer.playSegmentAt() has race condition: async dispatch for segmentPause delay doesn't re-check isPlaying before calling playText(). If user pauses during delay, playText() still executes and starts synthesis of next segment.
Symptom: User clicks pause between segments, but next segment starts playing after segmentPause delay expires. Repeated button mashes create chaotic state.
onPlaybackFinished() at line 540 checks isPlaying at line 595 AFTER queuing async dispatch. Pause command changes isPlaying but dispatch already queued.

summary: Race condition in SuttaPlayer.playSegmentAt(): when pause is clicked during segmentPause delay between segments, the async-queued playText() call ignores the pause and starts synthesis anyway. User sees next segment play unexpectedly after clicking pause. Button mashing amplifies chaos. Fix: add guard isPlaying check inside the DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter closure at line 456-459.
